landing.problemTitle: Family care is fragmented. Families deserve better.
landing.problemText: Modern families juggle fragmented health routines, medications, meals, schedules and elder care — scattered across notes, memory and guesswork. NasmaCare unifies all of it into one AI-powered family wellbeing platform, so care for the people you love becomes intelligent, proactive and shared.
landing.pillarsEyebrow: Built on four pillars of family wellbeing
landing.pillarsTitle: Every feature serves your family. Nothing else.
landing.pillarsSubtitle: In the UAE's Year of Family, we focus on what multigenerational households truly need — health, nourishment, time together, and peace of mind.

health.title: Family Health
health.desc: Medication intelligence, adherence analytics and elder safety — caring for parents and grandparents under one roof.

nutrition.title: Family Nutrition
nutrition.desc: AI meal plans that respect allergies, diabetes, hypertension and your budget — healthy food the whole table enjoys.

time.title: Family Time
time.desc: One intelligent schedule that balances school, work and clinic visits — and fixes clashes before they stress you out.

peace.title: Peace of Mind
peace.desc: Predictive alerts and a caring AI assistant watch over your loved ones, so working parents can finally breathe.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything your family needs, one caring platform
landing.featuresSubtitle: Not passive tracking — proactive AI that predicts, prevents and suggests, every single day.
landing.bentoChatReply: Mariam week: BP averaged 128/82, glucose stable, 96% of doses on time. One gentle alert on Tuesday — report is ready to share.
landing.howSubtitle: Four purpose-built engines work together on-device — no API key, no cloud, fully bilingual.

understand.title: It understands
understand.desc: A bilingual intent engine understands Arabic and English — “Plan low-sugar dinners this week” — and acts instantly inside the app.

solve.title: It solves
solve.desc: A constraint solver balances allergies, medical conditions, ages and your AED budget to build a week of meals everyone can enjoy.

predict.title: It predicts
predict.desc: Statistical anomaly detection (z-score + clinical rules) watches blood pressure and glucose, flagging risks before they become emergencies.

summarize.title: It summarizes
summarize.desc: Weekly bilingual health reports turn raw readings into clear, printable guidance you can share with your doctor.

stats.intents: AI intents understood in Arabic & English
stats.recipes: bilingual family recipes in the planner

landing.storiesSubtitle: A multigenerational Emirati household — two working parents, two kids, and Grandma Mariam at its heart.

story1.quote: I used to track my mother's pills in a notebook. Now NasmaCare reminds us, records every dose, and warns me before a refill runs out.
story1.name: Fatima
story1.role: Mother of two, caring for Mariam, 72

story2.quote: Dinner was a daily puzzle — my mother's diabetes, Omar nut allergy, and a monthly budget. The AI now plans our whole week in seconds.
story2.name: Ahmed

story3.quote: Football, tutoring and Grandma's clinic visits finally fit in one calendar. NasmaCare spots the clash and suggests the fix before Mum worries.
story3.name: Omar, 14

landing.ctaTitle: Give your family the care they deserve
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join NasmaCare and let AI carry the mental load — so you can be present for the moments that matter.

medications.title: Smart Medication Intelligence
medications.desc: Per-member schedules, adherence analytics, missed-dose risk scoring and refill countdowns — so no dose is ever forgotten.

meals.title: AI Meal Planner
meals.desc: Constraint-solving weekly plans from 40+ bilingual recipes, honoring allergies, conditions and budget — with an automatic shopping list.

schedule.title: Family Schedule Intelligence
schedule.desc: One shared week view that detects clashes automatically and suggests the smart fix before chaos happens.

safety.title: Elder Safety & Predictive Alerts
safety.desc: Blood-pressure and glucose tracking with AI anomaly detection and printable weekly reports for total peace of mind.

assistant.title: Nasma AI Assistant
assistant.desc: Just ask — in Arabic or English. Nasma understands, navigates, plans and summarizes across the whole platform.
